### **Relive the Day at Climb’s TOLA Partner Summit at Cowboys Golf Club** **in Dallas, Texas.**


***Experience the energy, conversations, and moments that made this Partner Summit one for the books!***


---


Our TOLA Partner Summit at Cowboys Golf Club in Grapevine, Texas brought together partners, peers, and colleagues for a day that was equal parts business and pure fun on the fairways of the world’s first and only NFL-themed golf club. The morning kicked off with check-in, brunch, and practice swings, while guests lit up cigars and connected with vendors at the vendor fair, each conversation earning a chance to win a free foursome at Cowboys Golf Club. Then it was time for the shotgun start, where the energy only grew as golfers made their way across the course. One of the day’s biggest highlights came from our Hole Hecklers, two professional stand-up comedians who roasted every golfer as they teed off, delivering nonstop laughs while raising money for \[charity name\]. Between great conversations, friendly competition, and plenty of laughter, the day was the perfect way to strengthen relationships and give back to the local community.
